ctx.x: Uh, how about...uh, I read in one of these magazines that Bunk Johnson visited California in 1905...

I never met Bunk. That's Jelly Roll's particular friend. He was a trumpet player, I think, too. Bunk Johnson was. He's one of them New Orleans greats like uh...uh...what's his name? Armstrong! But he was a home boy. See? He stayed in New Orleans all the time, but everybody knew...heard about him because he was so great, you know.
I just wondered, because it said he came to California in 1905, and I just wondered if you ever heard anything about that.
